research_question: Does a source-addressed magnitude-two local credit packet repair prior wrong A updates on unseen, independently materialized private-cue maps?

independent_materialization.generator: Reuse the separately implemented, hash-pinned online-budget held-out row generator, not the development selector or candidate. Generate new seed/cue identities and private maps.
independent_materialization.map_rule: Rank cues by SHA-256 of seed|cue|A-map or seed|cue|B-map; first four map to 0, last four to 1.
independent_materialization.training_rows: Complete 8x8x2x2 action factorial repeated twice, then random.Random(seed+2111).shuffle.
independent_materialization.test_rows: Complete 8x8 cue factorial repeated twice, then random.Random(seed+2221).shuffle.
independent_materialization.oracle: Independently reconstruct SHA rank as integers for all private targets and verify each XOR/global outcome. For the first encountered training event of each A cue, verify that B's inverted and correct local codes imply opposite A packet signs.

repair_schedule.initial_B_labels: One inverted private target per B cue before training, deliberately adversarial.
repair_schedule.early_A_updates: Exactly one wrong packet update on the first encountered event of each A cue; eight source-matched A/B anchors retained.
repair_schedule.late_B_revision: After all training episodes, clear inverted B local votes and observe one exact correct target per B cue.
repair_schedule.replay: One source-keyed B-to-A packet per replay tick, eight ticks maximum. Magnitude bucket two is permitted only when revised sign opposes recorded prior sign; A applies at most two signed local steps.
